resources.string: How much the launcher draws and moves. Lighter choices keep it smooth on TVs with little memory; what it shows stays the same.
This TV starts with the lighter choices, as it has little memory (or its config asks for them): no card shadows, Reduced motion and no animated details. What you choose here wins.
Sets every choice below to its lightest: Motion off, no card shadows or glow, a plain backdrop and nothing animated.
Light mode: every choice at its lightest
Page slides, focus scale and fades
The soft shadow under artwork and tiles (Midnight has none)
The theme\'s light around the focused tile; the focus ring stays
The photo or drawing behind Home, or the theme\'s plain sky colour
Snow or rain over Seasonal pictures while Home is idle
